blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A suspected drone attack hit the Marshall Islands-flagged oil products tanker MT Velos Sapphire in the Persian Gulf on Nov. 5, resulting in the death of a Filipino seafarer, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) has confirmed. Twenty-one other Filipino crew members onboard the vessel were unharmed, the DMW said. “The vessel was sailing toward Sitrah, Bahrain, when the explosion occurred, and initial reports suggested a possible drone attack.
